name: Tava Truglacier
source:
Tava's body is host to several different entities, all living together harmoniously in symbiosis.

Seemingly cold and approachable, Tava chooses to avoid socialising with the other operators at SSL, leading to the assumption that they are somehow sour. No one has ever seen Tava's true face beneath the mask.
